svg.title: Register map BS-TGR – drawing 43-06
svg.text: Register map example – BS-TGR (CNC external thread grinder), holding registers, 0-based
4 blocks = 4 kinds of request · counters + process block = registers 20 – 67 (48 registers, one FC03) · same map on all 8 BS-TGR
FC03 start 0 qty 12 · header, status, handshake
FC03 start 20 qty 48 · std + grind + tgr
• REAL / UINT32 at EVEN offsets (gap reg.)
• REAL = ABCD, UINT32 high word first
W = written by the gateway: 226 +1 every 1 s (FC06);
PLC watchdog: 226 unchanged 5 s = gateway lost
EXAMPLE – check with your network designer
